title: Born with it?
goal: Find out where most of the changes that lead to cancer come from.
intro: Cancer starts with changes to the genes inside a cell. After several changes, a cell can stop following the rules. Some people are born with one change already. Where do most changes come from?

prediction.question: Where do most of the changes that lead to cancer come from?
options: Mostly from genes passed down in the family
Mostly from changes that happen during a person's life
Only from bad luck with no causes at all

cases.answer: Only from bad luck with no causes at all
Mostly from changes that happen during a person's life
Mostly from genes passed down in the family
